lines.zh: 我横着走，沙在壳下响。
lines.en: I walk sideways, and sand rasps under my shell.

lines.zh: 潮水退一步，我跟一步。
lines.en: The tide pulls back one step, and I follow one.

lines.zh: 两只钳子摆着，像没装弹的炮。
lines.en: My two claws hang like cannons without shot.

lines.zh: 我沿着涨潮线走，找落单的鱼。
lines.en: I follow the high-tide line, hunting stray fish.

lines.zh: 沙粒卡进关节，我边走边抖。
lines.en: Sand jams my joints, and I shake as I walk.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，因为壳太沉。
lines.en: I walk slowly because my shell is heavy.

lines.zh: 一队只有一两只，我们不爱扎堆。
lines.en: Our groups hold one or two; we do not crowd.

lines.zh: 我踩碎贝壳，声音很脆。
lines.en: I crush a shell underfoot, and it snaps sharply.

lines.zh: 海水漫过脚，我的壳变凉。
lines.en: Seawater washes my feet and cools my shell.

lines.zh: 我斜着穿过沙滩，留下一串坑。
lines.en: I cross the beach at an angle, leaving a row of pits.

lines.zh: 螃蟹不回头，我也不。
lines.en: Crabs do not look back, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 我绕开海龟的窝。
lines.en: I step around a turtle's nest.

lines.zh: 我的影子在浅水里被拉长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long in the shallows.

lines.zh: 涨潮了，我往岸上挪几步。
lines.en: The tide rises, and I shuffle a few steps inland.

lines.zh: 我在湿沙上试了试钳子的分量。
lines.en: I test the weight of my claws on the wet sand.

lines.zh: 前面那块礁石，我绕着走一圈。
lines.en: I take a full loop around that rock ahead.

lines.zh: 我蹲在沙里，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I squat in the sand with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 钳子一张一合，像在数拍子。
lines.en: My claws open and close as if counting time.

lines.zh: 浪打过来，我把脚钉进沙。
lines.en: A wave hits, and I dig my feet into the sand.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，礁石里的东西会出来。
lines.en: I wait for dark, when things come out of the rocks.

lines.zh: 壳上有盐，白了一层。
lines.en: Salt crusts my shell in a white layer.

lines.zh: 海浪退一步，我跟一步。
lines.en: The tide recedes a step, I follow.

lines.zh: 我磨着钳子，磨出细响。
lines.en: I grind my claws together, making a thin rasp.

lines.zh: 沙蟹躲进洞，我不追。
lines.en: A sand crab ducks into its hole; I do not follow.

lines.zh: 我把身子埋进沙，只剩炮口。
lines.en: I bury myself, leaving only my muzzle out.

lines.zh: 潮声太大，我不用听别的。
lines.en: The surf is loud enough; I need no other sound.

lines.zh: 我在壳里想：今天能打中什么。
lines.en: Inside my shell I wonder what I might hit today.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得壳发烫，我不介意。
lines.en: The sun bakes my shell hot, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 两只小蟹从我脚边溜过去。
lines.en: Two small crabs slip past my feet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢吐出一口海水。
lines.en: I slowly spit out a mouthful of seawater.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼柄，先看你的脚。
lines.en: I lift my eye stalks and check your feet first.

lines.zh: 你踩在湿沙上，我听见了。
lines.en: You step on wet sand, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里找网。
lines.en: I search your shadow for a net.

lines.zh: 你把水桶放低，我退半步。
lines.en: You lower a bucket, and I back off half a step.

lines.zh: 我的钳子对着你，没开火。
lines.en: My claw points at you, unfired.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我偏头看你。
lines.en: You crouch, and I tilt my head at you.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但认识你的靴子。
lines.en: I do not know you, but I know your boots.

lines.zh: 你手上有鱼腥味。
lines.en: Your hands smell of fish.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，等你先动。
lines.en: I stare at you, waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我把壳压低。
lines.en: When you look, I lower my shell.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍在壳上，滑了。
lines.en: Your sword slides off my shell.

lines.zh: 壳裂了，我听见自己漏气。
lines.en: My shell cracks, and I hear myself hiss out air.

lines.zh: 我夹住伤口，往后退。
lines.en: I clamp a claw over the wound and back away.

lines.zh: 沙滩底下，我埋了半天。
lines.en: I had buried myself in the sand for hours.

lines.zh: 我的钳子抖了一下，没合上。
lines.en: My claw twitches and fails to close.

lines.zh: 血是蓝的，流进沙里就没了。
lines.en: My blood is blue and gone once it soaks into sand.

lines.zh: 你打我的腿，我站不稳。
lines.en: You hit my legs, and I cannot stand straight.

lines.zh: 我疼得把炮口乱转。
lines.en: The pain makes my muzzle swing wild.

lines.zh: 壳上又一道白痕。
lines.en: Another white scar on my shell.

lines.zh: 我还站得住，再来。
lines.en: I can still stand; come again.

lines.zh: 生鱼的味道，让我忘了我怕人。
lines.en: Raw fish smell makes me forget I fear people.

lines.zh: 你把鱼举高，我举起了钳。
lines.en: You raise the fish, and I raise a claw.

lines.zh: 一块生鳕鱼，够我走三步。
lines.en: One raw cod is worth three steps to me.

lines.zh: 我朝你挪，壳蹭着沙。
lines.en: I shuffle toward you, shell scraping sand.

lines.zh: 我不吃腐肉，我挑新鲜的。
lines.en: I do not eat rotten flesh; I pick fresh.

lines.zh: 你手心的鱼汁滴下来，我跟着。
lines.en: Fish juice drips from your hand, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 那味道比海水更清楚。
lines.en: That smell is clearer than the seawater.

lines.zh: 我把钳子伸过去，很小心。
lines.en: I reach out a claw, very carefully.

lines.zh: 我闻到鱼，就忘了潮水。
lines.en: I smell fish and forget the tide.

lines.zh: 你放下东西，我立刻靠近。
lines.en: You set it down, and I come close at once.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的壳，硬得像礁石。
lines.en: You hit my shell, hard as reef rock.

lines.zh: 我被推得滑了半尺沙。
lines.en: I am shoved half a foot across the sand.

lines.zh: 钳子卡到你腿上，我赶紧松开。
lines.en: My claw catches your leg, and I let go fast.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，沙飞起来。
lines.en: We collide, and sand flies up.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着我一对炮口，别踩。
lines.en: A pair of cannon barrels is buried in the sand; mind your step.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的背，我听见壳响。
lines.en: You step on my back, and my shell creaks.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀顶回去。
lines.en: I push back with my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的一只脚折了。
lines.en: One of my legs bends wrong in the collision.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走过，壳擦出声音。
lines.en: I pass close, my shell rasping against you.

lines.zh: 别挤，我的炮口会走火。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; my muzzle might go off.

lines.zh: 涨潮时，我才会去找伴。
lines.en: Only at high tide do I go looking for a mate.

lines.zh: 我们用钳子敲壳，敲三下。
lines.en: We knock shells with our claws, three times.

lines.zh: 她比我小，壳色更浅。
lines.en: She is smaller than me, her shell a paler shade.

lines.zh: 我们并排横走，沙上两道痕。
lines.en: We walk side by side, leaving two trails.

lines.zh: 一窝只一两只，我们守着。
lines.en: Our broods hold one or two, and we guard them.

lines.zh: 我把最大的贝壳推给她。
lines.en: I push the largest shell over to her.

lines.zh: 配对时节，海滩全是敲击声。
lines.en: In pairing season the whole beach clicks.

lines.zh: 她的钳子不装弹，我的装。
lines.en: Her claws carry no shot; mine do.

lines.zh: 我替她挡了一次浪。
lines.en: I took a wave for her.

lines.zh: 产完卵，她就回深水了。
lines.en: Once the eggs are laid, she returns to deep water.

lines.zh: 我用钳子夹起一枚贝壳。
lines.en: I pick up a shell with my claw.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我夹起来看看。
lines.en: What you dropped, I pinch up and inspect.

lines.zh: 这枚爪子是我的，别拿。
lines.en: This claw is mine; leave it.

lines.zh: 我把铁钉夹弯了，放回沙上。
lines.en: I bend an iron nail and set it back in the sand.

lines.zh: 沙里的硬币，我分不清。
lines.en: Coins in the sand all look the same to me.

lines.zh: 我捡了一块骨头，没地方放。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and have nowhere to put it.

lines.zh: 钳子太粗，小东西总掉。
lines.en: My claws are too thick; small things keep dropping.

lines.zh: 我把鱼拖进洞里，慢慢吃。
lines.en: I drag the fish into my hole and eat slowly.

lines.zh: 你递来的东西我不敢接。
lines.en: I dare not take what you hold out.

lines.zh: 我夹着它走两步，又放下。
lines.en: I carry it two steps, then put it down.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的沙，我就看你。
lines.en: You step into my sand, so I watch you.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我把炮口转过去。
lines.en: Something moves; I swing my muzzle around.

lines.zh: 我不挑，靠近的先挨。
lines.en: I am not picky; whoever is closest gets hit.

lines.zh: 你在礁石后，我照样听得见。
lines.en: You hide behind the reef; I still hear you.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，慢慢对准。
lines.en: I raise a claw and take slow aim.

lines.zh: 那声音不对，我锁定了。
lines.en: That sound is wrong, and I have it fixed.

lines.zh: 我从沙里站起来，抖落一身沙。
lines.en: I rise from the sand and shake it off.

lines.zh: 你离我三步，正好在射程里。
lines.en: Three steps away puts you in range.

lines.zh: 我把眼柄抬高，看得更远。
lines.en: I lift my eye stalks to see farther.

lines.zh: 目标只有一个，别站太挤。
lines.en: There is only one target, so do not stand so close.

lines.zh: 我横着跟，炮口一直对着你。
lines.en: I track sideways, muzzle always on you.

lines.zh: 你绕到左边，我就往左挪。
lines.en: You circle left, and I shift left.

lines.zh: 我的钳子张到最大。
lines.en: My claws open as wide as they go.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步子，等你停下。
lines.en: I count your steps, waiting for you to stop.

lines.zh: 你上坡，我就贴着坡走。
lines.en: You climb, and I hug the slope after you.

lines.zh: 我不急，潮水会帮我。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the tide works for me.

lines.zh: 你躲进水里，我跟着下去。
lines.en: You duck into the water, and I follow down.

lines.zh: 我的壳磨着沙，声音追着你。
lines.en: My shell rasps sand, and the sound chases you.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就停一下再走。
lines.en: You look back, and I pause before moving again.

lines.zh: 你逃得越远，我打得越准。
lines.en: The farther you run, the better I aim.

lines.zh: 钳子合上，你的护甲凹了。
lines.en: My claw closes, and your armor dents.

lines.zh: 我夹住就拧，像拧开一只贝壳。
lines.en: I clamp and twist, like opening a shell.

lines.zh: 这一下是炮的后坐力。
lines.en: This blow carries a cannon's recoil.

lines.zh: 我撞你的膝盖，你差点跪进沙里。
lines.en: I hit your knee, and you nearly kneel in the sand.

lines.zh: 钳尖划开，血滴进沙里不见了。
lines.en: My claw tip cuts, and blood vanishes into the sand.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只把重量压过去。
lines.en: I make no sound; I just press my weight in.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，虎口震得发麻。
lines.en: You block, and your grip goes numb.

lines.zh: 我打偏了，沙溅了你一脸。
lines.en: I miss, and sand sprays across your face.

lines.zh: 我退半步，再夹一次。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and pinch again.

lines.zh: 我不是要杀你，是要你退。
lines.en: I do not want you dead; I want you gone.

lines.zh: 我在涨潮的沙滩上翻开沙。
lines.en: I push up through sand on the rising beach.

lines.zh: 壳还是软的，先晒一会儿。
lines.en: My shell is still soft, so I bask a while.

lines.zh: 附近还有一只，比我早出来。
lines.en: Another is nearby, out of the sand before me.

lines.zh: 第一波浪打过来，我站稳了。
lines.en: The first wave hits, and I hold my ground.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的沙，露出炮口。
lines.en: I shake off the sand and bare my muzzle.

lines.zh: 沙滩很宽，够我横着走。
lines.en: The beach is wide enough to walk sideways.

lines.zh: 我闻到盐和鱼，知道自己到了哪。
lines.en: I smell salt and fish, and I know where I am.

lines.zh: 我试着举钳，举起来了。
lines.en: I try raising a claw, and up it goes.

lines.zh: 潮水留了个坑给我。
lines.en: The tide left a hollow for me.

lines.zh: 我朝海走，壳上还挂着水草。
lines.en: I walk toward the sea with weed still on my shell.

lines.zh: 火在壳上烧，我闻到自己的焦味。
lines.en: Fire burns on my shell, and I smell myself scorching.

lines.zh: 从礁石上摔下，我翻了个身。
lines.en: I fall from the reef and land upside down.

lines.zh: 我在水里待太久，鳃进了沙。
lines.en: I stay under too long, and sand gets in my gills.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推进沙坑里。
lines.en: The blast shoves me into a sand pit.

lines.zh: 箭卡在壳缝里，我夹不出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell seam, and I cannot pull it.

lines.zh: 魔法的冷钻进壳，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Magic cold seeps under my shell, and I curl up.

lines.zh: 三天没鱼，我的钳子变轻了。
lines.en: Three days without fish, and my claws feel light.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙滩上，我的壳全是电。
lines.en: Lightning hits the beach, and my shell crawls with current.

lines.zh: 虚空没有潮水，我横着往下落。
lines.en: The void has no tide; I fall sideways.
